rpi_i2c_init.tooltip: Open a Linux I2C bus with smbus2.

rpi_i2c_read_byte_data.tooltip: Read an 8-bit value from an I2C register.

rpi_i2c_write_byte_data.message0: I2C %1 write byte address %2 register %3 data %4
rpi_i2c_write_byte_data.tooltip: Write an 8-bit value to an I2C register.

rpi_i2c_read_word_data.tooltip: Read a 16-bit little-endian SMBus word from a register.

rpi_i2c_write_word_data.message0: I2C %1 write word address %2 register %3 data %4
rpi_i2c_write_word_data.tooltip: Write a 16-bit little-endian SMBus word to a register.

rpi_i2c_read_i2c_block.message0: I2C %1 read block address %2 register %3 length %4
rpi_i2c_read_i2c_block.tooltip: Read a block of bytes from an I2C register.

rpi_i2c_write_i2c_block.message0: I2C %1 write block address %2 register %3 data %4
rpi_i2c_write_i2c_block.tooltip: Write a list of bytes to an I2C register.

rpi_i2c_write_read.message0: I2C %1 repeated-start address %2 write %3 read %4 bytes
rpi_i2c_write_read.tooltip: Write bytes and read the response in one repeated-start I2C transaction.
